semantics.strategy: outermost-leftmost: at each step, try the root (rules in order), then the arguments left to right; one rewrite per step
semantics.rules: the rules of the profile certified over the reals, in priority order
semantics.matching: syntactic; a pattern's bound variable matches the input's bound variable; integers compare by value
semantics.conditions: a conditional rule applies only when each of its conditions, with the match substituted, is closed (integers, +, -, *, /, unary minus, integer powers) and decided true by exact rational arithmetic; otherwise it is left alone
